## Activity

The monthly activity record for North City Eye Clinic shows 493 captures completed during July 2024. This provides the reported total for the site and month. The activity figure is carried forward for review alongside the image-quality and grading results. No new equipment faults were raised during the month.

## Image quality

Of the 493 captures, 11 were marked ungradable. The recorded ungradable rate was 2.2. These results identify the number of captures that could not be used for grading and provide the corresponding rate for the reporting period. The image-quality outcome is included to support routine monitoring of the service.

## Grading

A total of 123 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 8. This is the reported midpoint for the time taken to complete grading during July 2024. The referable result and median lag should be considered together with the activity and image-quality figures when reviewing the site’s monthly operation.
